decisions.reason: The connector placement and orientation decision does not change the established board orientation, dimensions, USB-C edge placement, or mounting-hole requirements.
Physical placement and orientation of the battery JST do not change the NTC terminal, connector assignment, or thermal-monitoring behavior.
The connector-layout decision does not alter the battery protection controller or electrical cutoff behavior.
Battery JST placement and orientation do not affect the charge-status display method, GPIO, or dedicated-LED decision.
The referenced interboard connector layout does not change I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The source concerns battery and board JST connectors, not the selected USB-C connector or its sourceability requirements.
The connector-access decision does not change the addressable LED family, power interface, or data GPIO.
Battery and interboard connector placement does not alter the boost converter, enable control, default state, or powered loads.
